text:
andre: pushing a tiny hotfix for kv cache eviction leak hitting eu-edge. low risk but customers spiking. need fast approval to pin and bypass regular canary window.

deploy-bot: [deploy queued] hotfix/kv-evict-fix-2026-03-22 -> canary=staging, target=eu-west1, owner=@andre. Job id: db-8721. Estimated run: 03:45 UTC.

andre: overview: patch updates eviction TTL from 30s->60s for short-lived traces. no schema changes, no model artifacts. smoke tests pass locally.

ops_lead: what is rollback plan if we see regressed latency or 5xx?

andre: rollback plan: immediate pin to previous image tag, drain new pods via `kubectl rollout undo deployment/kv-proxy --to-revision=2` and shift traffic back to canary pool A. script saved in ops-runbook: `ops/rollback/kv-evict-rollback.sh`

sara: added a quick perf probe to prod telemetry to watch p99 & rps during rollout. will alert if p99>200ms or error rate >0.5%.

maria: +1 on monitoring. release notes? small changelog line or internal only?

andre: release note (short): "Hotfix: increased kv eviction TTL to mitigate edge cache churn causing brief 429s for embeddings reads." Will add more in full release doc after cut.

ops_lead: can we get two ops + one eng signoff to bypass the full 2-hour canary? we usually need 3 approvals for late-window.

maria: +1 (ops) :thumbsup:

sara: +1 (oncall) :eyes:

andre: pinging product for impact ack, but this is rollback-safe and transient. requesting expedited approval for immediate push in the 03:45 UTC slot.

release-bot: New release note draft created: https://internal.releases/redwood/notes/kv-evict-fix-2026-03-22 (preview).

deploy-bot: Deploy job db-8721 moved to running. Canary step: 10% traffic -> 50% in 5m -> 100% in 10m if health checks remain green. Auto-rollback enabled on failed health-checks.

andre: verifying canary healthcheck window settings: `--hc-window=60s --consecutive-fails=3`. happy to tighten if needed.

ops_lead: approved to bypass extended canary based on rollback plan and monitor thresholds. proceeding.

maria: leaving a final note: tag release with `hotfix/kv-evict-fix@v1.0.1-hotfix` and add to postmortem if we see recurrence.

andre: thanks all. I'll watch the rollout and call rollback if anything odd.

deploy-bot: Deploy job db-8721 succeeded. Canary health: ok. Traffic ramped to 50%.

sara: telemetry looks stable for first 2m. p99 unchanged, error rate down 0.1%.

maria: marking approvals in the ticket. i'll draft the short release blurb for external changelog after midnight.

andre: good catch team. I'll follow up with a short postmortem if we need it.

deploy-bot: Rollout completed to 100%. No auto-rollback triggered. Job db-8721 closed.

ops_lead: closing approve — thanks. keep this thread for post-rollout notes. :rocket:
